experimentPlan.embargo: Every origin target must finish strictly before partition end
experimentPlan.comparison: Same eligible origins, compare frozen v0.1, diurnal and constant flux
experimentPlan.promotion: Full guidance remains experimental. June-August +24h MAE and RMSLE must beat diurnal persistence; 90% range coverage within 5 points; MAE must beat v0.1 on same cohort. Otherwise keep v0.1 operational and publish candidate research evidence. September is reporting only, no model selection or tuning. Report ablations even if inputs do not help.
experimentPlan.uncertainty: Paired 7-calendar-day block bootstrap of daily mean absolute errors; storms remain correlated; not independent origins
experimentPlan.caveat: Development interval already inspected for v0.1. Historical source receipt times and complete provider revision history unavailable. Prospective verification pending.

developmentNote: The June-August cohort was already used in v0.1 development. The first v0.2 evaluation exposed an overly strict missing-spacecraft guard; it was corrected to ignore already-masked missing flux. Dates, forest hyperparameters and promotion gate were unchanged. September is therefore an additional retrospective check, not a pristine prospective test.
publicationDecision: Keep current v0.1 as default. Publish v0.2 combined guidance as a shadow comparison after range-coverage gate failure. No automatic refitting or promotion.
